description: This file contains configuration and utility functions for authentication and API setup in a React frontend project. It manages API base URL, tenant secret salt, and localStorage-based authentication session handling.

methods.name: normalizeBase64Url
methods.description: Normalizes a base64 URL string by replacing '+' with '-', '/' with '_', and removing padding '=' characters.

methods.name: getStoredAuth
methods.description: Retrieves and parses the stored authentication object from localStorage, returning null if invalid or missing.

methods.name: isAuthenticated
methods.description: Checks if the user is logged in based on the presence of a valid auth object in localStorage.

methods.name: saveAuthSession
methods.description: Saves a login session into localStorage, optionally including a token.

methods.name: clearAuthSession
methods.description: Removes the authentication session from localStorage.
